rules.description: aiku iris: drop the tracking parameters Varnish strips (utm, gclid, fbclid...) before the edge cache, so an ad or newsletter landing shares the page's edge copy; the browser keeps them in the address bar, where traffic sources and the Google/Meta tags read them
rules.expression: (http.host eq "__HOST__") and (not (http.request.uri.path eq "/app" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/app/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/json" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/json/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/disclosure" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/disclosure/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/unsubscribe" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/unsubscribe/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/locale" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/locale/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/models" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/models/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/catalogue" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/catalogue/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/invoice" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/invoice/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/attachment" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/attachment/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/admin" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/nova" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/nova/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/api" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/horizon" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/horizon/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/telescope" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/telescope/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/i" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/i/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/analytics" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/analytics/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/webhooks" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/webhooks/"))) and any(http.request.uri.args.names[*] in {"_branch_match_id" "_bta_c" "_bta_tid" "_ga" "_gl" "_ke" "_kx" "campid" "cof" "customid" "cx" "dclid" "dm_i" "ef_id" "epik" "fbclid" "gad_campaignid" "gad_source" "gbraid" "gclid" "gclsrc" "gdffi" rules.description: aiku iris: cache anonymous storefront pages at the edge for 72h (a 404 for 1h); Varnish bans purge them by the aiku-website-<id> Cache-Tag within 10 min (mirrors Varnish pass rules; logged in, Inertia and API traffic bypass)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "__HOST__") and (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) and (not http.cookie contains "iris_vua") and (not any(lower(http.request.headers.names[*])[*] eq "x-inertia")) and (not any(lower(http.request.headers.names[*])[*] eq "authorization")) and (not http.request.uri.path.extension in {"pdf" "csv" "css" "js" "mjs" "map" "jpg" "jpeg" "png" "gif" "svg" "webp" "avif" "ico" "woff" "woff2" "ttf" "eot" "otf" "php" "txt" "xml" "json"}) and (not (http.request.uri.path eq "/app" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/app/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/json" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/json/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/disclosure" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/disclosure/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/unsubscribe" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/unsubscribe/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/locale" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/locale/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/models" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/models/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/catalogue" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/catalogue/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/invoice" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/invoice/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/attachment" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/attachment/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/admin" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/nova" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/nova/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/api" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/horizon" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/horizon/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/telescope" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/telescope/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/i" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/i/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/analytics" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/analytics/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/webhooks" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/webhooks/"))) and (not http.request.uri.path eq "/health-ping") and (not http.user_agent eq "aiku-cache-warmer")

rules.description: aiku iris: never store pages drawn in the browser because SSR was down (Varnish never stores them either)
aiku iris: never store JSON at the edge (Inertia responses share the page URL; Varnish keys them, Cloudflare cannot)
aiku iris: never store a bot's own copy (Varnish marks it X-Aiku-Bot-Copy): deploy flushes spare bot copies, so one stored here could hand a person a pre-deploy page
